messages:
ana: Kicking off a tiny thread to capture the 'auditor replay' playbook we discussed. Goal: auditors should be able to request an evidence bundle and deterministically replay the chain (event -> receipt -> export) without exposing tenant PII. Need quick alignment on minimal fields and who owns which artifact.

rui: Core idea: events remain pseudonymized. Each ingest produces an `event_id`, `ingest_ts`, `tenant_hash`, `retention_label`, `tamper_hash`, and `ingest_sig`. Keystore operations produce signed receipts referenced by `receipt_id`. Export bundles glue them together via `bundle_id`.

lara: Security wants: HSM-signed `ingest_sig`, `tamper_hash` chaining (previous_hash -> current_hash), `evidence_category`, and `schema_version`. Also require `bundle_manifest` to include verifier public keys and a signature over the bundle.

ben: Legal asks that retention overrides and legal holds be represented as immutable records with `hold_id`, `created_by`, `approval_chain`, and `biz_justification`. Exports should include pointers to those records when relevant.

mike: Ops notes: implement `bundle_id` as `sha256(bundle_contents)` and store it in the export index. Purge worker must skip items with active `hold_id`. We'll also surface `export_latency_ms` and `export_size_bytes` metrics.

ana: Minimal sample we can put in the PR docs (short): ```json
{"event_id":"e-20260401-01","ingest_ts":"2026-04-01T12:00:00Z","tenant_hash":"sha256:aa11","retention_label":"enterprise_7y","receipt_id":"r-20260401-99","tamper_hash":"sha256:aaa","ingest_sig":"base64:XXX","evidence_category":"inference","schema_version":"evidence-v2","bundle_id":"b-20260401-1"}
```

rui: For BYOK: receipts contain `key_id` but they live only in the keystore's signed logs. Exporter includes the signed receipt in the bundle; the event only references `receipt_id`.

lara: Also require `control_tags` (list) so auditors can filter by SOC2/ISO controls. Add `schema_change_note` id to help auditors reason about schema drift.

ben: We'll draft an auditor-facing checklist that maps these fields to verification steps: 1) verify bundle signature and `bundle_id` hash, 2) confirm tamper chain by hashing sequence, 3) validate receipts against keystore public key, 4) check hold/override records.

mike: I'll add automated test that builds a bundle in staging and runs the checklist. Also will add an alert if export generation fails.

ana: Launch criteria (short): spec merged, sample bundles reproducible in staging, control_tags mapped to SOC2/ISO, retention/hold behavior tested, keystore receipts included in export, auditor checklist drafted.

rui: I'll open a small PR with sample payloads + receipts flow.

lara: Security will review control mappings and HSM design tomorrow.

ben: Legal will prepare hold policy and approval template.

audit-bot: PR #612 opened "auditor-replay-playbook" by ana. CI: schema lint OK, export smoke failing (missing receipt in example).

ana: Thanks all. Target to lock by EOW so we can include the playbook in next sprint planning. Ping me if you need help.
